g.text: On this page you will find:
– 3D-print files for the chassis and the arm
SCAN FOR DOCS, CODE AND LESSONS
Replacement parts, add-on sensors and the arm module:
Design files are published. Print it, fix it, improve it, share it.
– 3 x 18650 lithium cells (not included) and a USB-C charger
– A computer or tablet with a browser, or the Arduino IDE
– Charge the robot fully before the first lesson
– Fit the arm module only after the drive base runs
Plastal-Bot Builders is a Lusaka makerspace that teaches
robotics, coding and fabrication to learners and teachers across
Zambia. RoboCore is our own controller family, designed so a
class can build, program and repair its robots locally.
WORKSHOPS · TEACHER TRAINING · ROBOTICS CLUBS · FABRICATION
Share what your class builds, find lesson plans and compare
notes with other schools. Replacement parts, add-on sensors
and the arm module are available from us; the design files are
published so you can also print and fix parts yourself.
LESSON PLANS · FORUM · SPARE PARTS · DESIGN FILES
For replacement parts and the arm module visit plastalbotbuilders.com/robocore
Designed and built in Zambia by Plastal-Bot Builders, Lusaka

INSIDE (mirrored: prints on the back of the outside sheet). RoboCore V2 mailer box, roll-end tuck-top, outer 273 x 203 x 83 mm, E-flute 1.5 mm. Print 1:1; navy solid = cut, grey dashed = fold. Bar = 100 mm.
